targets.rawSql: SELECT "timestamp" AS "time", temperature_c AS "Controller temperature C", position_mm AS "Position mm", battery_voltage_v AS "Battery V", ina226_current_ma AS "INA current mA", ina226_power_w AS "INA power W" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY "timestamp";

SELECT "timestamp" AS "time", modbus_air_temperature_c AS "Air temperature C", modbus_humidity_pct AS "Humidity %RH", modbus_pressure_pa AS "Pressure Pa" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} AND modbus_valid IS TRUE ORDER BY "timestamp";

SELECT "timestamp" AS "time", modbus_average_wind_speed_ms AS "Wind speed m/s", modbus_average_wind_direction_deg AS "Wind direction deg", modbus_rain_intensity_mm_h AS "Rain mm/h", modbus_solar_radiation_wm2 AS "Solar W/m2" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} AND modbus_valid IS TRUE ORDER BY "timestamp";

WITH sisgeo AS ( SELECT m."timestamp" AS "time", item.device->>'device_index' AS device_index, NULLIF(item.device->>'value1','')::double precision AS value1, NULLIF(item.device->>'value2','')::double precision AS value2 FROM public.multiconnect AS m CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(m.lora_sisgeo_devices, '[]'::jsonb)) AS item(device) WHERE $__timeFilter(m."timestamp") AND m.controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} ) SELECT "time", 'SISGEO ' || device_index || ' Value 1' AS "metric", value1 AS "value" FROM sisgeo WHERE value1 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT "time", 'SISGEO ' || device_index || ' Value 2' AS "metric", value2 AS "value" FROM sisgeo WHERE value2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "time";

WITH sisgeo AS ( SELECT m."timestamp" AS "time", item.device->>'device_index' AS device_index, NULLIF(item.device->>'temperature_c','')::double precision AS temperature_c, NULLIF(item.device->>'humidity_pct','')::double precision AS humidity_pct, NULLIF(item.device->>'supply_voltage_v','')::double precision AS supply_voltage_v FROM public.multiconnect AS m CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(m.lora_sisgeo_devices, '[]'::jsonb)) AS item(device) WHERE $__timeFilter(m."timestamp") AND m.controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} ) SELECT "time", 'SISGEO ' || device_index || ' Temperature C' AS "metric", temperature_c AS "value" FROM sisgeo WHERE temperature_c IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT "time", 'SISGEO ' || device_index || ' Humidity %RH' AS "metric", humidity_pct AS "value" FROM sisgeo WHERE humidity_pct IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT "time", 'SISGEO ' || device_index || ' Supply V' AS "metric", supply_voltage_v AS "value" FROM sisgeo WHERE supply_voltage_v IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "time";

SELECT "timestamp" AS "time", CASE WHEN modbus_valid IS TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Modbus online", CASE WHEN jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(lora_sisgeo_devices, '[]'::jsonb)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END AS "SISGEO data present" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY "timestamp";

SELECT "timestamp" AS "time", battery_percent AS "Battery %", rssi AS "RSSI dBm", snr AS "SNR dB" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY "timestamp";
